about: Freelance illustrator who also runs a small online print shop, on hosting and payment accounts they pay for personally. Has a child in preschool.
cares_about: Financial and security alerts on accounts they own: bank, payments, and the hosting the shop runs on. These matter even when automated.
A real person waiting on them: family, clients, the landlord, the preschool, doctors.
A real person reaching out personally about a specific commission or collaboration.
does_not_care_about: Newsletters and digests, even ones they read.
Marketing, promotions and cold sales pitches.
